notes: New AOs no longer need to touch a held AO: they can sit up to about one AO beyond your held AOs, or about 300 km in from Kuwait. Units still land in Kuwait and drive north through the AOs behind them

Moving or releasing a brigade is never blocked any more: you get a warning if it leaves AOs further north without support to the south. AOs only pull back on their own if they end up far beyond that reach
